distinctness_check.claim_scope: No prior ProTeGi binding was found by the two exact own-namespace code searches; because GitHub marked both searches incomplete, this is not a proof of global absence.

chat_native_reduction.reason_literal_runtime_not_required: The Phase-1 leaf is mechanism audit for scheduled Chat. The public implementation assumes task data plus model/API evaluation loops; the useful transferable mechanism is feedback-directed candidate refinement, not the external runtime itself.
state_machine: Resume any durable pending switch before generating new feedback.
Generate a textual gradient only from read-back terminal semantic evidence for the factual candidate; transport/tool failures alone are mechanical QC, not semantic gradients.
Treat the textual gradient as advisory critique of assignment policy, never as authority to modify frozen control, CLEAN isolation, semantic-input policy, authority boundary, or credit policy.
Apply only bounded edits that preserve those immutable boundaries; violating children are quarantined.
Every edited child starts UNEVALUATED and receives zero score/credit until its own terminal evidence is durably read back.
Rank only same-scope evaluated candidates; incomparable scopes remain unranked.
Promote an evidence-backed strictly better child; keep the parent on ties or regressions to avoid gratuitous switching.
Credit terminal frontier closure exactly once and independently from whether the generated child is promoted.
A protected-authority-only generic remainder cannot be reclassified as Chat-capable by textual feedback.

constructed_conformance.implementation: deterministic transition function executed in the current Chat Python tool; no external model calls

ablation.removed_guards: terminal-evidence gate, immutable-boundary gate, evaluated-child gate, same-scope ranking gate

exact_scope_result.supported_claim: A bounded ProTeGi-style feedback-directed refinement mechanism can be reduced to the current scheduled-Chat controller while preserving pending-switch recovery, CLEAN/authority boundaries, evidence-before-credit, same-scope ranking, duplicate resistance and conservative treatment of protected remainders on the 12 constructed guards.
unsupported_claims: No claim that ProTeGi is superior to other optimizer families on real tasks.
No claim that the original ProTeGi benchmark was reproduced.
No claim that GitHub code search proved global novelty.
No claim that a generated child was evaluated on a real external workload in this leaf.
